nikhil: Quick sync: EU on-prem pilot - we need a hardened keystore path. Focus: RBAC lock, wrapped-key cache semantics, netpol egress, and incident steps.

laura: Failure modes? total HSM blackout, intermittent TLS drops, auth token expiry. We should define behavior for each.

ron: Proposed behaviour: fail-closed for writes, allow cache-backed reads only if node attested. No silent fail-open.

laura: Cache: encrypted envelope with fields (wrapped_key_id, exp_ts, node_id) and an HMAC that includes node cert serial. Store on encrypted volume, mount read-only after init. TTL default 24h.

nikhil: Attestation: mTLS + short-lived attestation token (ttl=5m). Local unwrap requires valid token. Proxy signs unwrap attempts; control-plane verifies.

ron: Circuit-breaker: if KMS p50 > 1s for 30s or error rate > 5% for 1m -> open for 120s, switch to cache-only read mode, emit alert to #eng-oncall and sec-oncall-bot.

laura: Netpols: keystore-proxy egress only to (1) control-plane:8443, (2) customer KMS CIDRs:443, (3) auditsvc:6514/443. Example minimal snippet: `egress -> to: 198.51.100.0/24:443`

auditsvc: Ingest requirements: mTLS + per-event JWS, include node_id, seq_no, mode, reason, wrapped_key_id. We'll reject unsigned events. Retention: 1y hot, 5y cold.

nikhil: IR playbook (short): detect high unwrap rate -> cordon node -> revoke attestation -> rotate cache epoch -> collect unwrap logs t-24h..now -> forensics.

sec-oncall-bot: Playbook link https://redwood-internal/policies/priv-kms-quickplay pinned. Acknowledge with :white_check_mark:.

laura: Action owners: I own RBAC + netpols; Ron owns cache + attestation PoC; Nikhil owns circuit-breaker + alerts; Jen (ops) will own audits retention.

nikhil: I'll open PR with minimal manifests and an audit job to run for 14 days before enforcement.

ron: I'll start a PoC branch for node-bound cache HMAC (FIPS optional).

laura: Thanks. Keep the migration audit queries conservative.

nikhil: PR by EOD Friday.
